audience.accounts: US employers with 500 to 2,500 employees in healthcare and education, self-insured

offer.offer: The Benefits Leakage Report, built from the employer's own claims file, showing dollars lost to ineligible dependents.

message.claim: Cresthaven finds 3% to 5% of self-insured claims spend going to ineligible dependents, and removes them before renewal.
message.proof: 40 audits in 2026 found an average of 4%.
